mapper.select: select A.BOOK_DATE AS bookDate, NVL(B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NAME，B.SUBJECT_NAME)||'('||NVL(B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO，B.SUBJECT_NO)||')' AS subjectName, B.CD_FLAG AS cdFlag, B.CCY AS ccyFmt, B.B_CCY AS bCcyFmt, B.HAPPEN_AMT AS happenAmt, B.B_HAPPEN_AMT AS bHappenAmt, B.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS happenNumber, B.TRADE_ID AS tradeId, A.BOOK_TYPE AS bookType, A.OFFSET_FLAG AS offsetFlag FROM BOK_VOUCH_MAIN A INNER JOIN BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL B ON A.VOUCH_NUM = B.VOUCH_NUM WHERE A.VOUCH_NUM = #{seqNo}

select A.TRADE_ID AS tradeId, #{booksetId} AS booksetId, A.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, NVL(B.FINPROD_ABBR,A.FINPROD_ID) AS finprodAbbr, B.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, A.TRADE_PLAT AS tradePlay, CASE WHEN (B.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' OR B.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F23' OR B.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F24') THEN NVL(A.PRIN_AMT，A.TRADE_AMT） ELSE A.TRADE_AMT END AS tradeAmt, A.TRADE_DATE AS tradeDate, A.BUSI_TYPE AS busiType, A.PS AS psCode FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON B.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS C ON A.TRADE_ID = C.TRADE_ID WHERE A.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} OR C.ORDER_ID = #{tradeId} UNION select A.ORDER_ID AS tradeId, #{booksetId} AS booksetId, A.MY_ACCT_NO AS finprodId, B.ACCT_NAME AS finprodAbbr, 'F20' AS finprodType, NULL AS tradePlay, A.SETTLE_AMT AS tradeAmt, A.SETTLE_DATE AS tradeDate, A.BUSI_TYPE AS busiType, NULL AS psCode FROM STL_ORDERS A LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO B ON B.ACCT_NO = A.MY_ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = A.CCY WHERE A.ORDER_ID = #{tradeId} AND A.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiTypeOrder}
SELECT B.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, B.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr FROM BOK_BOOKSET A INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON B.FINPROD_ID = A.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID WHERE A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
